=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh:163-182 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Signal forwarding in _forward_signal may not fully propagate an outer timeout's kill sequence to the Codex process subtree.
  WHY: deepseek says only soft signals are forwarded and treats this as expected/tested behavior, while moonshot flags that only the immediate child is targeted and grandchildren can be orphaned, so the reviewers disagree on impact but both describe incomplete subtree cleanup.
- scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh:~218 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The heartbeat emission block only prints CODEX_HEARTBEAT when the selector loop has been idle for a full interval, so intermittent child output suppresses heartbeats.
  WHY: Grok says long-running calls that emit occasional stdout/stderr will defer heartbeat output for many minutes, defeating the observability goal.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:2486-2506 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new reviewer kill helper only targets the direct child PID and does not guarantee reaping the outer timeout wrapper or descendant processes.
  WHY: Grok says a late SIGTERM from timeout --kill-after can leave orphaned Codex processes that survive the job and contaminate the next concurrency iteration.
- scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh:90-100 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: An invalid CODEX_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECS disables heartbeats but still runs the wrapper with the fallback interval, without surfacing the existing warning.
  WHY: Grok says misconfigured values such as 0 or a non-integer silently put the wrapper into degraded mode and hide the warning from the job log.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh
  Line: the _forward_signal function (around the child_pgid lookup and signal forwarding logic, lines ~170-182)
  Problem: The pass-1 cross-pollination summary flags that signal forwarding may not fully propagate an outer timeout's SIGKILL to the Codex process subtree.
  Why: The last-run diff specifically addressed this by removing start_new_session=True, which puts the wrapped child back into the same process group as the outer timeout invocation, and the new regression test validates timeout --kill-after terminates the child; the remaining theoretical gap is that _forward_signal only handles SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP/SIGQUIT, not SIGKILL, so the child.send_signal(signum) branch only needs to cover the soft-signal case before timeout escalates to SIGKILL. This is not a runtime defect — it is the expected and tested behavior of the timeout --kill-after contract.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- File: scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh
  Location: _forward_signal function (lines 163-177)
  Issue: Signal forwarding only targets the immediate child process when child_pgid == os.getpgrp(). When the wrapped Codex command spawns subprocesses (grandchildren), a SIGKILL from outer timeout --kill-after may not reach them, potentially leaving orphaned processes.
  Suggested minimal fix: When child_pgid == os.getpgrp(), attempt to kill the child's children first with pkill -P before killing the direct child, or document this limitation in comments.
  Estimated lines changed: 4
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- File: scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh
  Line: ~218 (the heartbeat emission block after the selector.select loop)
  Problem: The Python wrapper only emits a CODEX_HEARTBEAT line when no I/O events occurred for the full INTERVAL_SECS. When the wrapped child (or grandchild) produces any output, the next_heartbeat_at reset path runs but the emission branch is skipped until the next full idle window.
  Why it fails at runtime: Long-running review/consolidate/judge calls that produce occasional stderr progress or stdout JSON fragments will suppress heartbeat output for many minutes, defeating the observability goal of the original issue.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Lines: 2486-2506 (the reviewer watchdog loop) + the new _reviewer_kill_pid helper
  Problem: The added _reviewer_kill_pid only runs pkill -TERM/-KILL on the direct child PID of the heartbeat wrapper (or the codex_bg_pid). The outer timeout wrapper (still present in review_conflict_resolve.sh, review_rb_judge.sh, validate_process.sh, etc.) and any descendant processes spawned by codex exec are not guaranteed to be reaped.
  Why it fails at runtime: A late-arriving SIGTERM from timeout --kill-after can leave orphaned Codex processes (especially under the new non-detached Popen) which then survive the job and pollute the next iteration in the pr-autofix concurrency group.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh
  Lines: 90-100 (interval validation) + the final `exec python3 -c "$(cat <<'PY' ...)" "$@"`
  Problem: Invalid CODEX_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECS now forces heartbeat_enabled=false but still spawns the full Python wrapper (with INTERVAL_SECS=30 fallback). The run_without_heartbeat path is only taken when python3 is absent; it never falls back when the interval is invalid.
  Why it fails at runtime: Mis-configured repo var (e.g. set to “0” or a non-integer string) silently disables heartbeats without emitting the existing ::warning:: to the job log. The caller has no visible signal that the wrapper is in degraded mode.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: “Wrap the long-running Codex invocations in review and validation paths: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh, scripts/review_consolidate.sh, scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, scripts/validate_driver.sh, and scripts/self_heal_validation.sh.”
  Expected change site: scripts/validate_driver.sh (and any other validate_*.sh that directly invoke codex before validate_process.sh)
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk in scripts/validate_driver.sh or any other validate_*.sh (LAST_RUN_CHANGED_FILES only touches validate_process.sh and self_heal_validation.sh). The linked issue explicitly listed validate_driver.sh; PR DIFF and LAST_RUN_DIFF contain no reference to it.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: “Add one focused regression test that proves heartbeat lines are emitted at the configured idle interval without breaking the wrapped command’s exit behavior.” (out-of-scope note for agents.md/README.md is satisfied).
  Expected change site: tests/test_codex_heartbeat.py (already present) + wiring in CI/stable workflows
  Evidence of absence: N/A — test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py already calls the contract test, which runs in mark-stable and test-and-mark-stable workflows. The test was strengthened in the last autofix run (stdin passthrough, activity marker, descendant-pipe case, timeout kill-after). This gap is closed.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
